## Problem and result

Describe the concrete problem and resulting behavior. Link a related issue if applicable.

## Verification

List relevant checks you actually ran, their results, and any checks not run.

## Review notes

Mention compatibility changes, telemetry uncertainty, or other limitations when relevant. For measurements, distinguish real observations from simulation and include quality checks. Do not attach private logs or credentials.

- [ ] Changes are focused and documented.
- [ ] Behavior changes have meaningful regression coverage where appropriate.
- [ ] Canonical skill changes were copied with `npm run sync:skill`, if applicable.
